title: Pipeline Integration — Wire Real Engines Into Print-to-Program Chain
description: The PrintToProgramPipelineEngine currently reimplements physics inline (Kienzle/Taylor) and generates G-code independently. This milestone refactors it to ACTUALLY CALL the existing production-tested engines: SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine (51 tests), PostProcessorPipelineEngine (130 tests), OperationSequencerEngine (79 tests), QuoteEstimatorEngine, FeatureRecognitionEngine, InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine, ROIAdvisorEngine. Each unit closes one gap in the chain with proper type adapters.

units.title: PrintToGeometry returns structured features alongside CadQuery script
units.description: Modify PrintToGeometryEngine.convert() to return a `recognized_features: RecognizedFeature[]` array in addition to cadquery_script. Each feature gets id, type, dimensions, position from the BlueprintFeature input — no CadQuery parsing needed, just pass through the structured data. This closes Gap #1 (CadQuery TEXT → Feature OBJECTS).
acceptance_criteria: GeometryResult interface gains `recognized_features: Array<{ id, type, dimensions, position, count }>`
New test: verify recognized_features matches input features

units.title: Inventory bridge — Pipeline calls UserToolLibraryEngine
units.description: Modify PrintToProgramPipelineEngine to import and call InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine.select() instead of hardcoded selectToolForOperation(). If no user inventory provided, fall back to catalog recommendation. This closes Gap #6.
acceptance_criteria: Falls back to catalog defaults if inventory empty
Tool condition_factor applied to S/F calculations
Missing tools logged in pipeline warnings
Tests: 2 new (inventory match, empty inventory fallback)

units.title: Pipeline calls SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine instead of inline Kienzle
units.description: Replace inline Kienzle/Taylor physics in PrintToProgramPipelineEngine with actual call to SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine.compute(). Map feature+tool+machine context to OrchestratorInput. This closes Gap #3 and upgrades from ~5 inline formulas to 67-point physics hub with MOPSO, stochastic CI95, stability lobes.
acceptance_criteria: OrchestratorInput built from: machine catalog lookup, tool selection, material DB, feature geometry
Stochastic results (CI95, Weibull) included in pipeline output
Falls back to inline physics if orchestrator fails

units.title: Pipeline calls OperationSequencerEngine for optimal ordering
units.description: Replace simple feature-type sorting with actual call to OperationSequencerEngine.sequence(). Map tool assignments + feature geometry to SequencerInput. Gains: topo sort, TSP tool-change minimization, thermal relaxation, deflection-aware sequencing. Closes Gap #2.
acceptance_criteria: Sequencer output (SequenceStep[]) feeds into S/F stage
Falls back to simple ordering if sequencer fails

units.title: Pipeline calls CNCProgramAssemblerEngine for G-code
units.description: Replace inline G-code generation with CNCProgramAssemblerEngine.assemble(). Map SpeedFeed results + sequence + controller to ProgramAssemblyInput. Gains: proper tool change management, coolant strategy, safe Z handling, multi-operation coordination. Closes Gap #4.
acceptance_criteria: Assembled G-code replaces inline gcode template

units.title: Pipeline calls PostProcessorPipelineEngine for controller-specific output
units.description: After G-code assembly, run through PostProcessorPipelineEngine for 26-stage optimization with controller dialect translation. Map machine name → MachineContext via catalog lookup. Closes Gap #5 partially.

units.title: Pipeline calls QuoteEstimatorEngine for physics-backed costing
units.description: Replace inline cost estimation with QuoteEstimatorEngine. Map cycle time + operations + material + quantity to QuoteEstimateInput. Closes Gap #5.
acceptance_criteria: Secondary ops, NRE, learning curve included

units.title: Pipeline calls ROIAdvisorEngine for upgrade suggestions
units.description: Wire ROIAdvisorEngine into pipeline final stage. Map missing tools + current setup + quote to ROI analysis. Closes Gap #7.
acceptance_criteria: Missing tools from inventory selector → ROI suggestions
